question: What configuration applies when the layout has one path and twenty-three units?
premises: The layout has a single path.

inference: A single-path layout of twenty-three units has an eightfold outer course.
uncertainties: The technical sense of dantaṃ and parāgama in this ritual layout is uncertain.
